AUTHOR: Knausgård
TITLE: Temperate fish detection and classification: a deep learning based approach
REGION: Southern and western/mid Norway (Austevoll, Agder, Trøndelag); Fish4Knowledge (Taiwan) for pre-training
SPECIES: Post-training: Symphodus melops male/female, Pollachius pollachius, Pollachius virens; dataset also includes C. rupestris, C. exoletus, G. morhua, M. molva, M. aeglefinus, S. acanthias
DATA: Own temperate detection set (619 images, 1943 fish) and classification set (GoPro + stereo-BRUV, 2014-2019); Fish4Knowledge (27,230 images) for classifier pre-training
V_EV: Sec. 2.1: 'We collected video data at several different locations, spanning depths from 1-40 meters ... reflects the natural variability in visibility and light conditions.'
D_EV: Sec. 4.1: 'The dataset for this experiment was randomly split in a 70% for training and 30% for verification.'
R_EV: Sec. 4.1: 'a live stream from an underwater camera located near a semi-submerged restaurant ... highly variable lighting conditions, and different camera angles not part of our training data.'
C_EV: no statement found (no detection confidence threshold reported; only qualitative error 'seaweed is detected as fish')
E_EV: Sec. 4.1: 'The approach reaches an average IoU of 0.6802' (only IoU/mAP/accuracy; per-species counting claimed in architecture but not evaluated)
ARCH: YOLOv3 (Darknet-53, single 'fish' class) + CNN-SENet classifier; benchmarks Inception-V3, ResNet-50, Inception-ResNet-V2
METR: IoU, mAP@0.5, classification accuracy (mean of 10 runs), confusion matrix, time per epoch
NOTE: Detector pre-trained on ImageNet; classifier pre-trained on Fish4Knowledge (underwater dataset) then post-trained on temperate data -> PRE coded 수중 데이터셋. Random image splits; individuals of S. melops captured multiple times but leakage not discussed. External check is a qualitative demo on a restaurant live-stream camera (different camera, lighting) with no numeric metrics -> R1=Y, R3=N. Fish4Knowledge pre-training test (99.27%) is on F4K's own random split, not external. No detection score threshold reported -> C_ALL=NR. NIMG = 619 detection + 1022 post-training classification images (own data only).
